source_name: NIST Genome in a Bottle Challenging Medically Relevant Gene benchmark
source_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
validation_scope: Manually curated HG002 benchmark records suitable for variant-calling comparison in the paired benchmark regions.
limitations: The benchmark contains isolated insertions and deletions only.
It is restricted to autosomes and selected challenging medically relevant genes, so it is not representative of genome-wide performance.
Being a benchmark record establishes technical truth for HG002, not clinical pathogenicity.
Tandem duplications may be represented as SVTYPE=INS with REPTYPE=DUP.

coordinate_derivation.deletion: Affected interval excludes the left VCF anchor: POS+1 through POS+len(REF)-1.
coordinate_derivation.insertion: Point is recorded at VCF POS and length is len(ALT)-len(REF).

license_note: NIST employee work is made available as a public service; see the dataset README for the complete notice.
